advisories.transactionCaveat: Safe inside a transaction block (CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION); acquires a brief DDL lock on public.platform_finish_job_run_v2.
advisories.securityDefinerNote: Portable SQL defines public.platform_finish_job_run_v2 as SECURITY INVOKER with SET search_path = public, pg_catalog. Managed deployments exposing SECURITY DEFINER RPCs or role-scoped grants must preserve SECURITY DEFINER, REVOKE/GRANT EXECUTE, and pinned search_path when adapting.
advisories.summary: Fences public.platform_finish_job_run_v2 against stale lease completions by locking public.platform_job_controls FOR NO KEY UPDATE before updating run rows and marking lost-lease runs skipped with error 'job_lease_lost'.

advisories.transactionCaveat: Portable SQL uses CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS inside migration transactions. Busy managed databases should adapt these statements to CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction block to avoid blocking concurrent outbox writes.
advisories.securityDefinerNote: Index-only DDL; no SECURITY DEFINER wrapper or function execute grants are affected.
advisories.summary: Adds partial indexes scoped to active outbox rows (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'failed')) so claim, per-aggregate ordering, and pending event-type checks remain O(active rows) when terminal rows are retained.

advisories.transactionCaveat: Safe inside a transaction block (CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION); acquires a brief DDL lock on public.fulfillment_advance_shipment.
advisories.securityDefinerNote: Portable SQL defines public.fulfillment_advance_shipment as SECURITY INVOKER with SET search_path = public, pg_catalog. Managed deployments exposing SECURITY DEFINER RPCs must preserve SECURITY DEFINER, execute grants, and pinned search_path when porting the lock order.
advisories.summary: Acquires the parent public.subscriptions row lock FOR UPDATE before locking public.fulfillment_shipments in public.fulfillment_advance_shipment to follow the canonical delivery-alignment lock order and prevent 40P01 deadlocks against concurrent renewal admission.
